description: Activate Brandcode Studio connection for saving and pushing brands. Preferred mode: "activate" gives a short code (e.g. BRAND-7K4X); the user types it at brandcode.studio/activate, checks the email shown, and clicks Approve — no copy-paste of tokens needed. Also supports: "status" (check auth), "login" (magic link fallback), "set_key" (manual token), "logout" (clear credentials). Use when the user wants to save their brand to Studio or says "activate", "connect to Brandcode", or "save my brand online". NOT needed for extraction, preview, or brand_check — those work without auth.

email.description: Email address for login. Required when mode="login".

key.description: mode="set_key": session token (JWT) from magic link verification. mode="activate": the short activation code (e.g. "BRAND-7K4X") returned by the first activate call, to check whether the user approved it.

mode.description: Auth action. "activate" (recommended) starts the device code flow: call with email to get a short code; the user opens brandcode.studio/activate, types that code, checks that it shows their email, and clicks Approve; then call again with key=<that short code> to finish. No token copy-paste. "status" checks if authenticated. "login" starts magic link flow (fallback). "set_key" stores token manually. "logout" removes credentials.

studio_url.description: Brandcode Studio base URL. Defaults to "https://www.brandcode.studio". Must be a trusted Studio origin; self-hosted/staging origins are added via the BRANDCODE_STUDIO_TRUSTED_ORIGINS environment variable.

name: brand_brandcode_auth
title: Brandcode Studio auth
